validity.recommendation: Row is a real pipeline and is not a duplicate.
validity.researcher_notes: The Gazprom page gives about 970 km, 1420 mm and 45 billion cubic meters per year for Ukhta-Torzhok 2, the same figures as the first line. The two rows may share one corridor, but they are separate pipes with separate commissioning years.

fills.researcher_notes: Capacity 45 billion cubic meters per year is confirmed. The Gazprom project page for Ukhta-Torzhok and Ukhta-Torzhok 2 states 45 billion cubic meters per year for each line and says the second line was commissioned in 2018. The sheet value stands.
Length 970 km is confirmed. The Gazprom project page states about 970 km for each of the two lines. The sheet value stands.
Diameter 1420 mm is confirmed by the same Gazprom project page.

Operator Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta is supported at medium. An April 2022 regional newspaper report on the company says it brought Ukhta-Torzhok 2 into service in 2021 and plans to finish the line with four compressor stations.

Owner Gazprom PJSC is supported at medium. The Gazprom annual report for 2022 lists the start-up of Ukhta-Torzhok 2 among the commissioning events of the company. The report does not name a separate project company.

status_reviews.staleness_rule: Annual update. A dated April 2022 report and a December 2018 trade report both show the line in service and no stop was found.
status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status operating is kept. A December 2018 trade report says the line is in operation. An April 2022 report says work to add compressor stations is still planned, which is about completing the line, not about a stop.
